evidence.title: Fintech Plaid Bets on Credit Scores to Fuel Next Phase of Growth

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid customer interviews and adoption records among consumer lenders
occurrences.quote_span: Consumer lenders are particularly interested because their loans are not collateralized and they want to know as much as they can about their prospective borrowers.
occurrences.speaker: Plaid
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Michelle Young interview or Plaid product statement
occurrences.quote_span: Traditional credit data looks at your willingness to repay. Cashflow data looks at your ability to repay,” Plaid’s Credit Product Lead Michelle Young said. “These signals together give lenders a more holistic view to actually make a decision.”
occurrences.speaker: Michelle Young
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid LendScore Arc technical documentation
occurrences.quote_span: It learns from the order and timing of a borrower’s transactions to predict their ability to repay debt, and the likelihood of delinquency.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid LendScore product specifications
occurrences.quote_span: The new version of LendScore offers specialized models for auto and home lending that predict creditworthiness for people with those specific types of loans.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Zach Perret interview or Plaid statement about phase-two product strategy
occurrences.quote_span: For our phase two, we started thinking about what are the areas where we can really make the product quality a lot better,” Chief Executive Zach Perret said. “One big one for us was in credit score.”
occurrences.speaker: Zach Perret
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid LendScore product specifications
occurrences.quote_span: It also has a short-term lending model designed for companies including buy now, pay later providers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid product announcements and roadmap disclosures
occurrences.quote_span: Plaid has hinted about launching new products to help businesses and consumers with the payments process.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid product documentation and lending outcomes for thin-file borrowers
occurrences.quote_span: The tools are also supposed to help people who have little to no credit history get loans by providing cashflow data instead.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid product launch announcement for LendScore 2 and new AI models
occurrences.quote_span: A year after the financial technology company released its first credit-risk tool, Plaid is launching a second version of LendScore alongside new AI models that are meant to give lenders more insight about potential borrowers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid internal customer-request records for credit products and services
occurrences.quote_span: Plaid said it receives roughly 8 million customer requests a month for credit products and services.
occurrences.speaker: Plaid
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid LendScore 2 product documentation and launch record
occurrences.quote_span: LendScore 2, which is launching Tuesday, is designed to have a better rate of predicting someone’s likelihood of default on a loan payment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid product strategy and customer adoption records
occurrences.quote_span: The new specialized models are intended to attract more customers who might be apprehensive about new credit technology.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid LendScore methodology documentation
occurrences.quote_span: The model uses cashflow data—which includes information on how much someone has saved and how often they pay bills on time—to predict the likelihood that a borrower will pay back a loan.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid LendScore 2 documentation describing lender data inputs
occurrences.quote_span: Lenders can use cash-flow data as a supplement or a replacement for traditional credit metrics such as the FICO score.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid credit-scoring products
